gaps: Apple Events: no typed inter-app messages with reply descriptors; the control socket and intents do not replace them.
File metadata: no attribute store or MDQuery-style query API for apps.
Dictionary Services: no definition lookup (spellcheck.rs covers spelling only).
Backup Core: no per-item backup exclusion.
Identity Services: no user or group API for apps.
File system events: no persistent event IDs, so a change stream cannot replay events after a restart.
Launch Services: no role handlers, shared file lists or quarantine properties.
Search Kit: the per-app content index has no term-level or summarization API.
Docs mismatch: docs/bifrost-ui.md names the FSEvents module fsevents; the code module is springboard/sdk/src/fswatch.rs.
